minutes.headline: ZBA granted a used-car special permit at 93 Whum Road, 4-1, conditioned on tax payments and site cleanup
minutes.summary: The board continued its hearing on a petition to sell used cars at 93 Whum Road. It read letters from the Treasurer/Tax Collector and the Board of Health, questioned the applicant, and granted the permit with conditions. It then heard and granted a dimensional special permit for a new house on New West Townsend Road, and adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals granted a special permit for used car sales at 93 Whum Road, 4-1, with conditions.
Conditions include tax compliance, a security fence and shrubbery, no equipment yard, a limit of three trucks at a time for repair, and Board of Health conditions.
The Treasurer/Tax Collector's letter reported back taxes owed at the property and a payment plan on which only some payments had been made.
The board amended the bylaw section cited on the Smith/Hawkins application, then granted a 7 ft dimensional special permit for a new house on New West Townsend Road.

why_it_matters: The Whum Road permit ties a new commercial use to payment of back property taxes, which touches how unpaid taxes at a single property are handled and the neighborhood's exposure to a used car and repair operation.
The New West Townsend Road permit allows a house to be built closer to the lot lines than the zoning bylaw otherwise permits.
